# Model: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, Sparsity: 20%
#
# Usage: bash scripts/run_floor_ablation.sh <floor_ratio> [gpu_id]
#   floor_ratio: e.g., 0.3, 0.5, 0.6
#   gpu_id: GPU index (default: 0)

set -euo pipefail

if [ $# -lt 1 ]; then
    echo "Usage: bash scripts/run_floor_ablation.sh <floor_ratio> [gpu_id]"
    exit 1
fi

FLOOR=$1
GPU=${2:-0}

source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base
cd /root/recovery_aware_struct_prune

MODEL_PATH="/root/autodl-tmp/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B"
CKA_PATH="results/cka_scores.pt"
BASE_DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/recovery_aware_struct_prune"

EXP_TAG="cka_only_20_floor_${FLOOR}"
PRUNED_DIR="${BASE_DIR}/pruned_${EXP_TAG}"
SFT_DIR="${BASE_DIR}/sft_${EXP_TAG}"
GRPO_DIR="${BASE_DIR}/grpo_${EXP_TAG}"
LOG_DIR="${BASE_DIR}/logs"

mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR" "${BASE_DIR}/results"

echo "========================================"
echo "Floor Ratio Ablation: floor=${FLOOR}"
echo "GPU: ${GPU}"
echo "Start: $(date)"
echo "========================================"

# ============================================
# Step 1: Pruning (CKA-only, sparsity=20%, floor=${FLOOR})
# ============================================
echo ""
echo "[Step 1/4] Pruning CKA-only, sparsity=20%, floor=${FLOOR} ..."
echo "  Output: ${PRUNED_DIR}"

if [ -f "${PRUNED_DIR}/pruning_metadata.pt" ]; then
    echo "  [SKIP] Already pruned."
else
    HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE=1 HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 python src/prune.py \
        --model_path "$MODEL_PATH" \
        --cka_path "$CKA_PATH" \
        --mode cka_only \
        --sparsity 0.20 \
        --floor_ratio "$FLOOR" \
        --output_path "$PRUNED_DIR" \
        --seed 42 \
        2>&1 | tee "${LOG_DIR}/prune_${EXP_TAG}.log"
    echo "[Step 1 DONE] $(date)"
fi

# ============================================
# Step 2: SFT Warmup (2 epochs)
# ============================================
echo ""
echo "[Step 2/4] SFT warmup (2 epochs, lr=2e-5) ..."
echo "  Input:  ${PRUNED_DIR}"
echo "  Output: ${SFT_DIR}"

if [ -f "${SFT_DIR}/config.json" ]; then
    echo "  [SKIP] SFT already done."
else
    HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE=1 HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 python src/train_sft_warmup.py \
        --model_path "$PRUNED_DIR" \
        --output_dir "$SFT_DIR" \
        --gpu_id "$GPU" \
        --num_epochs 2 \
        --lr 2e-5 \
        --batch_size 1 \
        --gradient_accumulation_steps 8 \
        --seed 42 \
        2>&1 | tee "${LOG_DIR}/sft_${EXP_TAG}.log"
    echo "[Step 2 DONE] $(date)"
fi

# ============================================
# Step 3: GRPO 100 steps (v5 config)
# ============================================
echo ""
echo "[Step 3/4] GRPO 100 steps ..."
echo "  Input:  ${SFT_DIR}"
echo "  Output: ${GRPO_DIR}"

if [ -d "${GRPO_DIR}/checkpoint-100" ]; then
    echo "  [SKIP] GRPO checkpoint-100 already exists."
else
    HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE=1 HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 python src/train_grpo_v5.py \
        --model_path "$SFT_DIR" \
        --output_dir "$GRPO_DIR" \
        --gpu "$GPU" \
        --max_steps 100 \
        --learning_rate 1e-6 \
        --per_device_train_batch_size 2 \
        --gradient_accumulation_steps 8 \
        --max_completion_length 512 \
        --temperature 0.4 \
        --repetition_penalty 1.15 \
        --num_generations 4 \
        --beta 0.01 \
        --loss_type dapo \
        --format_reward_weight 0.1 \
        --gradient_checkpointing true \
        --optim adamw_8bit \
        --save_steps 100 \
        --save_total_limit 3 \
        --run_name "grpo_${EXP_TAG}" \
        --seed 42 \
        2>&1 | tee "${LOG_DIR}/grpo_${EXP_TAG}.log"
    echo "[Step 3 DONE] $(date)"
fi

# ============================================
# Step 4: GSM8K Evaluation (N=1319)
# ============================================
echo ""
echo "[Step 4/4] GSM8K evaluation (N=1319) ..."
echo "  Model: ${GRPO_DIR}/checkpoint-100"

EVAL_OUTPUT="${BASE_DIR}/results/eval_gsm8k_floor_${FLOOR}.json"

if [ -f "${EVAL_OUTPUT}.done" ]; then
    echo "  [SKIP] Eval already done."
else
    HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE=1 HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 python src/eval_gsm8k.py \
        --model_path "${GRPO_DIR}/checkpoint-100" \
        --output_path "$EVAL_OUTPUT" \
        --max_samples 1319 \
        --seed 42 \
        --dtype bfloat16 \
        2>&1 | tee "${LOG_DIR}/eval_${EXP_TAG}.log"
    echo "[Step 4 DONE] $(date)"
fi

# ============================================
# Summary
# ============================================
echo ""
echo "========================================"
echo "Pipeline Complete: floor=${FLOOR}, $(date)"
echo "========================================"

if [ -f "$EVAL_OUTPUT" ]; then
    /root/miniconda3/bin/python3.12 -c "
import json
d = json.load(open('$EVAL_OUTPUT'))
print(f'GSM8K Accuracy: {d[\"accuracy\"]:.4f} ({d[\"n_correct\"]}/{d[\"n_total\"]})')
print(f'EOS rate: {d[\"eos_stats\"][\"eos_rate\"]:.4f}')
"
fi
", "stderr": "", "return_code": 0}, "error": null, "metadata": {"elapsed_seconds": 0.44}}
